title: Vintage Couple Outdoor Portrait, 1940s B&W Snapshot
description: A post-WWII black-and-white snapshot depicting a neatly dressed couple standing side-by-side along a rural driveway or road. The man is wearing a double-breasted suit with wide lapels, and the woman wears round eyeglasses, a light trench coat over a striped skirt, and holds a small parcel and book. To the right, the front end of a late-1940s automobile is visible, with a multi-story house situated on a wooded hill in the background. The photograph features decorative scalloped/deckled borders common in mid-century amateur prints.
